decisive_items: Regular rhythm with cannon A waves in the jugular venous waveform
QRS complexes outnumber P waves with 3:2 relationship
P-wave morphology shows negative deflection in leads II and aVF
response.rationale: R4 uniquely integrates the retrograde P-wave pattern, cannon A waves, and the 3:2 QRS:P ratio, which are hallmarks of AVNRT. R1 is contradicted by the QRS:P ratio (flutter requires more P waves than QRS), R2 cannot explain QRS outnumbering P waves, and R3 requires a 1:1 AV relationship.

rejected.why: Atrial flutter requires atrial rate > ventricular rate; the 3:2 QRS:P ratio and negative P waves in II/aVF are not flutter.
OAVRT requires a 1:1 AV relationship; the 3:2 QRS:P ratio and cannon A waves are not explained.
